title: Best AI Visibility Tools: See Where You Rank in 2026
rawContent:
TL;DR:

AI visibility isn’t just about getting mentioned in ChatGPT or Google AI, it’s also about where you appear, who gets cited instead, which competitors are showing up and whether AI search is actually sending traffic to your site. This guide compares four tools from different angles: Semrush for broader visibility and content opportunities, OtterlyAI for ongoing mentions and citation tracking, SE Ranking for competitor and source analysis and SiteGuru for measuring actual AI-driven traffic. The right choice depends on whether you want to track visibility, understand citations, analyze competitors or measure real traffic.

What Is an AI Visibility Tool?

An AI visibility tool helps you see how often your brand or website appears in AI-generated search results. It can track mentions, citations, rankings, competitors and even traffic coming from AI platforms.

Quick Comparison of the Best AI Visibility Tools

Not every AI visibility tool measures the same thing. Some focus on brand mentions and citations, while others are better for competitor research or tracking actual traffic from AI platforms.

1. Semrush AI Visibility

Semrush AI Visibility helps you understand how your content and brand perform across AI-powered search. Instead of only showing whether your brand appears in AI answers, it helps identify visibility opportunities, topics, sources, mentions and citations so you can understand where your content is performing and where there is room to improve.

Semrush AI Visibility dashboard showing AI visibility data, topics, sources, mentions and content opportunities.

Key features

  • AI visibility tracking: Review your overall AI visibility score and understand how your content is performing in AI search.
  • Brand mentions & citations: See where your brand and content appear in AI-generated answers.
  • Topics & Sources: Discover topics AI platforms are already discussing and identify opportunities to gain more visibility.
  • Content opportunities: Find areas where you can create new content or improve existing pages for better AI visibility.
  • AI visibility reports: Use visual reports and data to understand performance without relying only on individual metrics.

Best for: Agencies, SaaS companies, brands and content teams publishing content at scale.

Pricing: Semrush AI Visibility is available as part of Semrush subscription plans, with pricing depending on the plan you choose.

My Experience

Semrush gave me the most complete picture of AI visibility among the four tools I tested. What stood out most was the Topics & Sources section because it didn’t just show whether a brand appeared in AI answers; it helped identify which topics deserved attention and where visibility opportunities existed.

The reports also provided a lot of detail, and the visualizations made the data easier to understand. For larger content teams, this can save significant research time.

The main downside is that Semrush can feel overwhelming because of the amount of data available. Smaller websites may not need every feature, but for agencies, SaaS companies and teams managing content at scale, it provides a comprehensive view of AI visibility.

2. Otterly AI Visibility Checker

OtterlyAI is an AI search visibility tool that tracks how often your brand appears in AI-generated answers across platforms such as ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity and Microsoft Copilot. You add the search prompts your audience might use and Otterly monitors those prompts daily to track brand mentions, rankings, competitors, sentiment and website citations.

Key features

  • AI visibility tracking: Monitor brand mentions, coverage, average position and share of voice.
  • Citation tracking: See which websites and URLs AI engines cite and how often your own content is referenced.
  • Competitor tracking: Compare your AI visibility with competing brands.
  • Prompt-level analysis: See performance for individual search queries and engines.
  • GEO Audit: Check whether your website is crawlable and accessible to AI crawlers.
  • Recommendations: Get optimization suggestions based on visibility and citation data.
  • Multi-country tracking: Monitor AI visibility across different markets.
  • Reports & integrations: Export data and connect it with API, Looker Studio or MCP.

Best for: Brands, SEO/GEO teams and agencies that want ongoing AI visibility, competitor and citation tracking in one dashboard.

Starting price: $29/month.

This format is much better for your Best AI Visibility Tools article because the reader can understand OtterlyAI in 30–45 seconds without getting buried in dashboard metrics.

My Experience

They show too much relevant information, so at first glance, it can feel a bit overwhelming. You may need to spend some time analyzing the data to understand it properly. Initially, all models are set by default, so it shows the overall data. But you can also select individual models and check the data separately. ChatGPT, Google AI Overview, Perplexity and Microsoft Copilot can be checked normally, but if you want to check Claude, Gemini and Google AI Mode, you need to pay for the add-ons.

3. SE Ranking

SE Ranking is an SEO platform with dedicated tools for tracking AI search visibility. It combines AI Visibility Tracking, Competitor Analysis and Source Analysis to show how your brand 

appears in AI-generated answers, which competitors are gaining visibility and which websites AI platforms rely on when generating answers.

SE Ranking dashboard showing AI visibility, competitor mentions and AI sources.

Key features

  • AI visibility tracking: Monitor how your brand appears in AI-generated answers.
  • Competitor analysis: See which competitors are gaining visibility for your target topics.
  • Source analysis: Identify which websites AI systems trust and cite.
  • Keyword & prompt tracking: Add keywords, topics, or prompts and monitor their performance in AI answers.
  • GEO insights: Use visibility and source data to identify content opportunities and improve your GEO strategy.

Best for: SEO agencies, consultants and content marketers.

Starting price: $103.20/month when billed annually.

My Experience

SE Ranking stood out to me because of its AI Competitor and Sources reports. Instead of only showing visibility scores, it helped identify which websites AI systems trust and cite. That information can be especially useful when planning content or link-building campaigns.

The reports were also straightforward and easy to understand, which made the tool more accessible compared with platforms that provide more complex AI visibility data.

4. SiteGuru 

SiteGuru takes a different approach to AI SEO by focusing on the actual traffic your website receives from AI platforms rather than mainly tracking mentions, citations, and competitors. It shows whether platforms such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity are sending visitors to your website and which pages benefit the most.

SiteGuru dashboard showing AI referral traffic and pages receiving visits from AI platforms.

Key features

  • AI traffic tracking: Track visits coming from different AI platforms.
  • AI referral insights: See which AI tools are sending visitors to your website.
  • Top AI pages: Identify which pages receive the most AI-generated traffic.
  • Organic vs AI traffic: Compare AI referral traffic with traditional organic search traffic.
  • Simple reporting: View AI traffic data through an easy-to-understand dashboard.

Best for: Bloggers, small businesses and website owners.

Starting price: $49/month.

My Experience

SiteGuru takes a different approach from the other tools I tested. Instead of focusing heavily on AI mentions and citations, it focuses on actual visits. I liked being able to see which AI platforms were sending visitors and which pages were benefiting the most.

The interface also felt simple and practical. If your main goal is to understand whether AI platforms are sending traffic to your website, SiteGuru is the simplest option.

AI Visibility Metrics Explained

AI visibility can mean different things depending on the tool, so it’s important to understand what you’re actually measuring.

How to Choose the Right AI Visibility Tool

The best tool depends less on the number of features and more on what you actually want to measure.

  • Want to understand your overall AI visibility and find content opportunities?
    Semrush gives you a broader view of visibility, topics, sources and content opportunities.
  • Want to track prompts, brand mentions, citations and competitors over time?
    OtterlyAI is built around ongoing monitoring across multiple AI search platforms.
  • Want to know which competitors and websites AI platforms rely on?
    SE Ranking is particularly useful for competitor and source analysis.
  • Want to see whether AI platforms are actually sending visitors to your website?
    SiteGuru focuses on AI referral traffic and shows which platforms and pages are generating those visits.

Conclusion

AI search is becoming another place where your brand needs to be visible, but not every tool measures visibility in the same way.

Semrush is a strong choice if you want a broader view of AI visibility and content opportunities. OtterlyAI is useful for ongoing tracking of mentions, citations, competitors  and prompts. SE Ranking stands out for competitor and source analysis, while SiteGuru makes the most sense when you want to see actual traffic coming from AI platforms.

The best option ultimately depends on what you want to measure: AI visibility, citations, competitors, content opportunities or actual AI-driven traffic.
